column3: The Hebrew repeats “all the days” and Joshua’s name and says the elders “knew” the LORD’s work; BSB uses one “throughout the days,” a pronoun for Joshua, and “had experienced.”
The Hebrew actively says “they buried” Joseph’s bones and uses the named unit “qesitahs”; BSB has the passive “were buried” and “pieces of silver.”
The Hebrew names “the hill of Phinehas his son” and says it was given “to him”; BSB treats Gibeah as the place name and explicitly names Phinehas as the recipient.
